verdict.rationale: A sandbox or test environment is a fair question for an LLM API platform, so the axis applies. The pack documents no DeepSeek sandbox, test mode, or separate non-production environment. The only nearby items are a "Rate Limit & Isolation" page about concurrency and per-user `user_id` management, plus a Harness developer preview; none of these is a sandbox isolated from production data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
